purpose: Dependency graph layered over manifest proof profiles. It defines prerequisite ordering and cross-backend blast-radius obligations without duplicating proof-profile descriptions.
rules: Prerequisites are transitive and must run in increasing proof-profile rank.
A failed cheaper prerequisite blocks promotion to more expensive proofs until explained or repaired.
Shared GL/shader/lowering changes have both native backend regression obligations even when the symptom was discovered in only one backend.
Legacy migration proof establishes the extracted invariant/oracle; it never proves clean-tree promotion by itself.
Physical presentation and paired performance are terminal claim proofs, not debugging starting points.
